opening.text: I'm an 88-year-old man with chronic kidney disease. I started a herbal medicine called Sai-rei-to 25 days ago, and about two weeks after that, my symptoms began. I have a dry cough, I've been short of breath, and I've had a fever and chills. Also, both of my lower legs are swollen.
